subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these final action-version revisions in workflows that execute with application private keys, publishing credentials, and Codex-agent secrets after reviewing the upstream action changes and final-head workflow evidence?
rationale: This is an intentional supply-chain trust decision about third-party executable workflow code in privileged contexts; automated diff inspection cannot choose the repository’s acceptable trust boundary.

options.title: Review and approve final SHAs
options.body: Verify the upstream revisions and attach redacted successful runs for the credential-bearing and release-sensitive workflows before merge.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Land only the non-privileged workflow action updates and defer token, publishing, and Codex-agent revisions for dedicated review.

options.title: Close and regenerate later
options.body: Close this Dependabot branch if the repeated rebases prevent stable review, then let Dependabot open a fresh pinned update.

recommendation.title: Review and approve final SHAs
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream revisions and attach redacted successful runs for the credential-bearing and release-sensitive workflows before merge.
